free_parameters.name: batch_size
free_parameters.why: witness does not fix the batch; one batch keeps the CPU run minimal and the target condition reads only seq_len

free_parameters.name: num_heads
free_parameters.why: witness does not fix the query head count; one head keeps the pre-target top-k work small and the branch does not read it

free_parameters.name: num_kv_heads
free_parameters.why: witness does not fix the KV head count; one KV head equals one query head so no GQA expansion is needed before the target

free_parameters.name: head_dim
free_parameters.why: smallest head_dim accepted by the function's guard, keeps the pre-target einsum small; the branch does not read it

free_parameters.name: block_size
free_parameters.why: largest accepted block size; the early-return guard and the target both use seq_len only, and 128 keeps the pre-target top-k cheap

free_parameters.name: vertical_size
free_parameters.why: with block_size 128 this gives 8 vertical blocks, so the early-return guard (seq_len <= min(vertical,slash)*block_size) is false as required to reach the target

free_parameters.name: slash_size
free_parameters.why: repository example value; with block_size 128 it keeps the early-return guard false and does not affect the target condition

free_parameters.name: gqa_interleave
free_parameters.why: function default; the branch at the target does not read it and one KV head means no interleave difference

free_parameters.name: dtype
free_parameters.why: CPU-only run; float32 is supported by every op before the target. The GPU launchers after the target reject it, which only stops the run below the decision

free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: fixed random seed so q/k/v construction is deterministic across repeats and replay

execution.entry_reason: The recorded call_chain[0] (flex_prefill_attention) never calls this op in the pinned source: it computes its own block indices and calls triton_block_wise_attention directly. vertical_slash_attention is the public op that contains the Region and is called by the llama/glm/qwen2 vertical-slash forwards, so it is the closest real entry on the path to the target.

mocks.reason: the optional GPU flash-attention package is not installed on the CPU box but the module under test imports it at module level; this shell only lets the import succeed and is not called before the target
GPU-only flash-attention launcher reached only by the early-return branch that the witness inputs do not take; replaced by plain torch so the run would stay on CPU if it were reached

availability probe called while the repository module imports; a plain Python function reports false, which is what the genuine absence of the package on this CPU box means. It only selects the module's GPU fallback binding
